steps.tactic: set T := n + 1 * (2 * m + 1) with hTdef
have hTq : (m + 1) * q + ρ = T := Nat.div_add_mod T (m + 1)
have hρm : ρ < m + 1 := Nat.mod_lt T (by omega)

have hTZ : ((n : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 * (2 * (m : ℤ) + 1) = ((m : ℤ) + 1) * (q : ℤ) + (ρ : ℤ) :=
  by
  have : ((T : ℕ) : ℤ) = (((m + 1) * q + ρ : ℕ) : ℤ) := by rw [hTq]
  rw [hTdef] at this; push_cast at this; linarith
have : ((T : ℕ) : ℤ) = (((m + 1) * q + ρ : ℕ) : ℤ) := by rw [hTq]

have hnd : n + 2 ≤ m ^ 2 + 4 * m + 2 :=
  by
  have : 1 ≤ m ^ 2 := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
  omega
have hTq' : (m + 1) * q + ρ + 2 ≤ m ^ 2 + 4 * m + 2 + 1 * (2 * m + 1) := by omega
have hTq'' : 1 * (2 * m + 1) ≤ (m + 1) * q + ρ := by omega

have h1 : q ≤ m + 4 := by
  by_contra hc; push Not at hc
  have : (m + 1) * (m + 4 + 1) ≤ (m + 1) * q := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hc
  nlinarith

have h2 : q = m + 4 → ρ + 3 ≤ m := by
  intro hqe
  rw [hqe] at hTq'
  nlinarith

have h3 : 1 ≤ q := by
  by_contra hc; push Not at hc
  have : (m + 1) * q ≤ (m + 1) * 0 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
  nlinarith

have h4 : q = 1 → m ≤ ρ + 0 := by
  intro hqe
  rw [hqe] at hTq''
  nlinarith

have h2' : q < m + 4 ∨ ρ + 3 ≤ m := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge q (m + 4) with hlt | hge
  · exact Or.inl hlt
  · exact Or.inr (h2 (by omega))
rcases Nat.lt_or_ge q (m + 4) with hlt | hge

have h4' : 1 < q ∨ m ≤ ρ + 0 := by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge 1 q with hlt | hge
  · exact Or.inl hlt
  · exact Or.inr (h4 (by omega))
rcases Nat.lt_or_ge 1 q with hlt | hge
rcases (show m % 3 = 0 ∨ m % 3 = 1 by omega) with hmr | hmr
rcases (show ρ % 3 = 0 ∨ ρ % 3 = 1 ∨ ρ % 3 = 2 by omega) with hr | hr | hr
have hsZ : (3 : ℤ) * (((ρ + 0 * (m + 1)) / 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (ρ : ℤ) + 0 * ((m : ℤ) + 1) := by exact_mod_cast hs
have htZ : ((q - 0 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (q : ℤ) - 0 := by rw [Nat.cast_sub (show 0 ≤ q by omega)]; norm_num
have hsZ : (3 : ℤ) * (((ρ + 2 * (m + 1)) / 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (ρ : ℤ) + 2 * ((m : ℤ) + 1) := by exact_mod_cast hs
have htZ : ((q - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (q : ℤ) - 2 := by rw [Nat.cast_sub (show 2 ≤ q by omega)]; norm_num
have hsZ : (3 : ℤ) * (((ρ + 1 * (m + 1)) / 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (ρ : ℤ) + 1 * ((m : ℤ) + 1) := by exact_mod_cast hs
have htZ : ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (q : ℤ) - 1 := by rw [Nat.cast_sub (show 1 ≤ q by omega)]; norm_num
rcases (show ρ % 3 = 0 ∨ ρ % 3 = 1 ∨ ρ % 3 = 2 by omega) with hr | hr | hr
have hsZ : (3 : ℤ) * (((ρ + 0 * (m + 1)) / 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (ρ : ℤ) + 0 * ((m : ℤ) + 1) := by exact_mod_cast hs
have htZ : ((q - 0 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (q : ℤ) - 0 := by rw [Nat.cast_sub (show 0 ≤ q by omega)]; norm_num
have hsZ : (3 : ℤ) * (((ρ + 1 * (m + 1)) / 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (ρ : ℤ) + 1 * ((m : ℤ) + 1) := by exact_mod_cast hs
have htZ : ((q - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (q : ℤ) - 1 := by rw [Nat.cast_sub (show 1 ≤ q by omega)]; norm_num
have hsZ : (3 : ℤ) * (((ρ + 2 * (m + 1)) / 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (ρ : ℤ) + 2 * ((m : ℤ) + 1) := by exact_mod_cast hs
have htZ : ((q - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (q : ℤ) - 2 := by rw [Nat.cast_sub (show 2 ≤ q by omega)]; norm_num
